issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares the attributes numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as double, but the reference solution declares both fields as int. Students following the UML may implement fields/constructor/getters/setters with double and then conflict with the intended API used by the tests/solution (e.g., getTotalNumberOfStudents() is specified/implemented as int).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent across artifacts: either update the UML/problem statement to use int for numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents (matching the solution and the int-based methods), or change the solution (and corresponding expected signatures) to use double consistently and define how int-returning methods should round/convert.
